messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into German, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE German line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑German Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **mosse** | “initial moments / hour” (plural) | **Stunde** | “hour” | **WRONG** (plural → singular) | | **di** (line 40) | genitive marker “of” | **der** | “of the” | OK | | **prima** | “first, earliest” | **erste** | “first” | OK | | **quelle** | demonstrative “those” | **die** | “the / those” | OK | | **cose** | “things, beautiful entities (season)” | **Jahreszeit** | “season” | OK | | **belle** | “beautiful / sweet” (qualifier) | **süße** | “sweet” | OK | | **sì** | resultative “so” | **so** | “so” | OK | | **ch'a** | causal conjunction “that” (part of “so that”) | **dass** | “that” | OK | | **bene** | “good” (quality of hope) | **guter** | “good” | OK | | **sperar** | infinitive “to hope” | **Hoffnung** | “hope” | OK | | **m'era** | “to me was” (experiencer + copula) | **mir … war** | “to me was” | OK | | **cagione** | “occasion, cause” | **Anlass** | “occasion” | OK | | **di** (line 42) | preposition “of / concerning” | **für** | “for / concerning” | OK | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” | **jenes** | “that” | OK | | **fiera** | “wild beast” | **wilde Tier** | “wild beast” | OK | | **a** (line 42) | preposition “with” | **mit** | “with” | OK | | **la** | definite article (feminine) | **der** | “the” (dative) | OK | | **gaetta** | “dappled, speckled” | **gesprenkelten** | “dappled” | OK | | **pelle** | “skin” | **Haut** | “skin” | OK |
---
### Issues Detected - **WRONG:** *mosse* → rendered as singular **Stunde** while the source is plural (“moments”). *(All other mappings are acceptable; no missing, grammar, or unnecessary items were found.)*

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only German script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final German text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 40: - Original: die erste Stunde der Zeit und die süße Jahreszeit; - Issue: WRONG (singular “Stunde” vs. required plural) - Corrected: die **ersten Stunden** der Zeit und die süße Jahreszeit; - Line 41: - Original: so dass es mir Anlass zu guter Hoffnung war - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 42: - Original: für jenes wilde Tier mit der gesprenkelten Haut - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
